notes.title: Leap of Love Dark Princesses Store Page
notes.content:
Hi guys,

The store page for the first DLC for Leap of Love is ready and you can now wishlist it!
 Here is a small preview of what you can expect when Dark Princesses release:
[list]
[*] 3 additional lovely princesses to seduce
[*] 15+ beautiful full screen artworks
[*] 15+ cute but scary chibis
[*] Full voice acting for the princesses
[*] 3 new terrifying locations to visit
[*] 15+ new spooky random events
[*] 7+ additional good endings
[*] 10+ new gruesome deaths
[*] 20+ achievements
[/list]

I'll send you some more info on the content as we approach release day ;)

Have fun

[b]Andrealphus[/b]

notes.title: Dark Princesses - Teaser #1
notes.content:
Hi guys :)

I hope you have been having fun with Leap of Love on Steam ^^

I wanted to share with you the design of the three new princesses coming up in Dark Princesses, the first DLC for Leap of Love.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39103775/f171a78fcd29f87c2050d58c386804e1e436e25f.png[/img]

From left to right we have:

- Jezebel, princess of Hell and daughter of Orcus
- Violaine, last princess of the vampire kingdom
- Calista, the spectral queen

In addition to the new waifus the DLC should have:
- 7+ new good endings
- 15+ new beautiful artworks
- 12+ new random events
- 3+ new locations 
- a host of new horrible ways of dying ^^

We are hard at work to bring you the DLC as soon as possible, it's around 50% written and the art is already ongoing ^^

See you soon,

[b]Andrealphus[/b]

tags.feature: - a host of new horrible ways of dying ^^
